page_title: RSO 2-1 SEV | Real Sociedad v Sevilla 24/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+4' Peque (Sevilla) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Alex Remiro.
90+3' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) is shown the yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. It could have been worse!
90+3' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Adrian Cordero has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
90' Alfonso Gonzalez (Sevilla) missed a great opportunity! He jumped for a cross and headed towards goal from the penalty spot, but the ball sailed well wide of the left post!
86' Here is a change. Sergio Gomez is going off and Sergio Francisco gives the last tactical orders to Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad).
84' Alfonso Gonzalez (Sevilla) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
79' That will be all from Djibril Sow who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Alfonso Gonzalez (Sevilla).
77' Peque (Sevilla) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
77' Akor Adams (Sevilla) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The ball goes out for a corner. Sevilla can continue in their attacking effort.
74' Sevilla keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
69' The referee allows time for a substitution. Goncalo Guedes will be replaced by Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad).
69' Here comes a substitution. Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) is brought on as a substitute for Brais Mendez.
69' Sergio Francisco has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) replacing Ander Barrenetxea.
65' Isaac Romero goes off the pitch and Akor Adams (Sevilla) comes on.
62' It looks like Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) saw red with that tackle. Adrian Cordero won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
60' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Sevilla comes to nothing.
59' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.
57' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) has tested the patience of referee Adrian Cordero and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
55' Sevilla fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
55' The attendance for today's match is 30965.
54' Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
53' A substitution has been made. Lucien Agoume goes off and Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) comes on.
53' Matias Almeyda has decided to make a change. Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) replaces Fabio Cardoso.
52' Substitution. Alexis Sanchez is replaced by Peque (Sevilla).
50' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Adrian Cordero had an easy-decision to make.
48' A corner kick by Real Sociedad is thwarted by the well prepared Odysseas Vlachodimos (Sevilla).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' The Real Sociedad players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' Sevilla failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
43' Real Sociedad couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Odysseas Vlachodimos (Sevilla) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
43' Foul! Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) is penalised for pulling back his opponent. There is a free kick near the sideline to Real Sociedad.
40' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.

36' 2 - 1 GOAL! A terrible mistake leads to a goal. The defender ends up losing possession, allowing Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) to pick up the ball before slotting it into the back of the net to make it 2:1.
34' Adrian Cordero shows a yellow card to Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) for his blatant foul.
33' Problems for Sergio Francisco as Yangel Herrera (Real Sociedad) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Carlos Soler replaces him.
30' 1 - 1 Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) picks it up in space and from the edge of the box lashes in a shot that is deflected past the helpless Alex Remiro. 1:1.
29' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Sevilla.
26' Marcao (Sevilla) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
23' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Adrian Cordero blows for a foul.
19' 1 - 0 Goal! Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) puts the ball into the bottom right corner past the outstretched arm of Odysseas Vlachodimos.
19' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
18' Referee Adrian Cordero is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Real Sociedad!
18' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Real Sociedad, he's going to review using VAR.
17' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Fabio Cardoso (Sevilla). It's a penalty! What an opportunity to score for Real Sociedad.
14' The corner is swung in but Sevilla can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

13' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla have been awarded a corner kick.
12' The resulting set piece from Sevilla is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
11' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. It will be a corner kick for Sevilla.
8' Sevilla can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
7' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) is flagged for offside.
2' Alexis Sanchez (Sevilla) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
1' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) takes a first-time shot from the edge of the box, but his effort is well blocked by the defender. The referee points to the corner flag and Sevilla will take a corner.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Sevilla will take the kick-off.
Adrian Cordero got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
